title: Spreading standard finite free stalk differential matrices to an affine open
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $x\in X$, $R=\mathcal O_{X,x}$ [def-pc-module-stalk-functor], $d:\mathbb Z\to\mathbb N$, and $a,b\in\mathbb Z$. Suppose $d(i)=0$ for $i<a$ or $b<i$. Let $F$ be a cochain complex of $R$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] whose degree-$i$ term is the standard free module $R^{d(i)}$. There are an affine open $U$ containing $x$ and a cochain complex $L$ of sheaves of modules over $\mathcal O_X|_U$ on the slice site of opens contained in $U$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. The terms of $L$ vanish outside $[a,b]$ and are isomorphic to the free sheaves of ranks $d(i)$. Applying ordinary direct image from $U$ and then the stalk functor at $x$ gives a complex isomorphic to $F$. This states only a local matrix lift, with standard input terms, and does not assert global boundedness or a comparison with restriction of direct image.

proof.text: Transport each term equality to an isomorphism eF i. Conjugate F.d i (i+1) by those isomorphisms. Cancellation of eF hom/inv and F.d_comp_d prove the square-zero equations for the coordinate maps delta.

Apply exists_squareZero_stalk_coefficients_spread to delta and the original support bounds. It gives an affine U containing x and square-zero section-ring maps D with the prescribed coefficient germs.

Use the existing affinePerfectSheafification X U hU. Convert the ULift finite coordinate modules to Finsupp on the ULift basis, apply tildeFinsupp, and transport the free sheaf along restriction and overEquiv using mapFreeIso. Assemble D by CochainComplex.of and apply affinePerfectSheafification degreewise. The rank-zero coordinate module is subsingleton, hence zero; functorial preservation of zero objects proves precisely the original bounds.

Apply exists_affine_freeSheaf_stalk_realization for its natural coordinate isomorphisms e. Compose eF i with e(d i) and construct the complex isomorphism by HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents. CochainComplex.of_d identifies the adjacent differentials with D i; coefficient naturality and cancellation of eF prove their commutation.

theorem exists_boundedFree_stalk_complex_local_lift
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (x : X) (d : ℤ → ℕ)
    (F : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.stalk x)) ℤ)
    (hterms : ∀ i : ℤ, F.X i = ModuleCat.of (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      (ULift.{0} (Fin (d i) → X.presheaf.stalk x)))
    (a b : ℤ) (hd : ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i → d i = 0) :
    ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ IsAffineOpen U ∧
      ∃ L : CochainComplex
          (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ,
        (∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i → IsZero (L.X i)) ∧
        (∀ i : ℤ, Nonempty (L.X i ≅ SheafOfModules.free
          (R := (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U) (ULift.{u} (Fin (d i))))) ∧
        Nonempty (F ≅
          (((SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u}
              (SheafOfModules.pushforwardOver (R := moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
            RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj L))
